capabilities: Convert pasted Nextcloud internal links into rendered file blocks
Authenticate to a Nextcloud server via Login Flow v2 and store app passwords
Connect multiple Nextcloud accounts as named profiles
Upload pasted non-image attachments to a Nextcloud folder set in the nc-folder frontmatter property
Prompt to move deleted files to the Nextcloud trash when their blocks are removed
disambiguation: Not a general-purpose Nextcloud file browser or sync client; it only renders pasted links as file blocks and uploads pasted attachments.
extras: Full walkthroughs for usage, prerequisites, and installation live on separate documentation pages rather than in the README.
problem: Pasting a Nextcloud link into a note leaves only a bare URL with no file details and no direct way to open the file on the server.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that turns pasted Nextcloud internal links into rich file blocks

requires.name: Nextcloud server with Login Flow v2

summary: Nextcloud integration that turns pasted Nextcloud internal links into rich file blocks with size, upload date, and an open-in-browser button.
